# Description

Subset the annotated *Schistosoma mansoni* reference atlas to cells annotated as muscle cells cells and export the subset as an AnnData/H5AD object.

This report:

- loads the annotated *S. mansoni* Seurat reference object
- identifies muscle cells using a configurable metadata column and regular expression
- subsets the Seurat object to muscle cells
- rebuilds a clean RNA-counts-based Seurat object for export
- writes the muscle subset as `.h5ad`
- optionally saves the muscle cells Seurat object as `.rds`

## Resolve paths

```{r resolve_paths, echo=TRUE}
output_dir <- dirname(params$output_h5ad_file)
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

path_table <- data.frame(
  object = c(
    "Input annotated Seurat object",
    "Output muscle H5AD object",
    "Output muscle Seurat object"
  ),
  path = c(
    params$input_seurat_file,
    params$output_h5ad_file,
    params$output_seurat_file
  ),
  exists = file.exists(c(
    params$input_seurat_file,
    params$output_h5ad_file,
    params$output_seurat_file
  )),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

kable(path_table, caption = "Input and output paths used by this report")
```

## Load annotated reference object

```{r load_reference_object, echo=TRUE}
if (!file.exists(params$input_seurat_file)) {
  stop("Input Seurat object not found: ", params$input_seurat_file)
}

srt_obj <- readRDS(params$input_seurat_file)

if (!inherits(srt_obj, "Seurat")) {
  stop("The input file did not contain a Seurat object.")
}

if (!params$annotation_col %in% colnames(srt_obj@meta.data)) {
  stop(
    "annotation_col not found in Seurat metadata: ",
    params$annotation_col,
    "\nAvailable columns include:\n",
    paste(colnames(srt_obj@meta.data), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

assay_names <- names(srt_obj@assays)

if (is.null(params$assay) || !is.character(params$assay) || length(params$assay) != 1) {
  stop("params$assay must be a single character value, e.g. assay: 'RNA'")
}

if (!params$assay %in% assay_names) {
  stop(
    "Requested assay not found in object: ", params$assay,
    "\nAvailable assays:\n",
    paste(assay_names, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

DefaultAssay(srt_obj) <- params$assay

reference_summary <- data.frame(
  metric = c("n_features", "n_cells", "default_assay", "annotation_col"),
  value = c(nrow(srt_obj), ncol(srt_obj), DefaultAssay(srt_obj), params$annotation_col),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

kable(reference_summary, caption = "Summary of the input annotated reference object")
```

## Subset parenchyma cells

```{r identify_cells, echo=TRUE}
clusters_to_keep <- unlist(params$clusters_to_keep)

cells_to_keep <- rownames(srt_obj@meta.data)[
  srt_obj@meta.data[[params$annotation_col]] %in% clusters_to_keep
]

if (length(cells_to_keep) == 0) {
  stop("No cells matched the requested cluster IDs.")
}

srt_obj_subset <- subset(
  x = srt_obj,
  cells = cells_to_keep
)

subset_summary <- data.frame(
  metric = c("n_features", "n_cells", "default_assay"),
  value = c(nrow(srt_obj_subset), ncol(srt_obj_subset), DefaultAssay(srt_obj_subset)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

kable(subset_summary, caption = "Summary of the muscle-only Seurat object")

```

## Rebuild counts-based export object

```{r rebuild_counts_based_object, echo=TRUE}

#srt_obj_subset <- JoinLayers(srt_obj_subset)

rna_counts <- Seurat::GetAssayData(
  object = srt_obj_subset,
  assay = params$assay,
  layer = params$layer
)

srt_obj_subset_export <- Seurat::CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = rna_counts,
  meta.data = srt_obj_subset@meta.data,
  project = "S_mediterranea_muscle"
)

export_summary <- data.frame(
  metric = c("n_features", "n_cells", "default_assay"),
  value = c(nrow(srt_obj_subset_export), ncol(srt_obj_subset_export), DefaultAssay(srt_obj_subset_export)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

kable(export_summary, caption = "Summary of the counts-based object prepared for H5AD export")
```

## Export muscle subset

```{r export_subset, echo=TRUE}
sce <- Seurat::as.SingleCellExperiment(srt_obj_subset_export)

zellkonverter::writeH5AD(
  sce = sce,
  file = params$output_h5ad_file
)

if (isTRUE(params$save_intermediate_files)) {
  saveRDS(srt_obj_subset, params$output_seurat_file)
}

output_table <- data.frame(
  object = c("S. mansoni muscle H5AD object", "S. mansoni muscle Seurat object"),
  file = c(params$output_h5ad_file, params$output_seurat_file),
  exists = file.exists(c(params$output_h5ad_file, params$output_seurat_file)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

kable(output_table, caption = "Output files produced by this report")
```
